import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from lightgbm import LGBMClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import os
import warnings
import gc

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("input/sample_submission.csv")

if sample_sub.empty:
    sample_sub = pd.DataFrame({"id": []})

# Ensure sample_submission has required columns
required_cols = [
    "toxic",
    "severe_toxic",
    "obscene",
    "threat",
    "insult",
    "identity_hate",
]
for col in required_cols:
    if col not in sample_sub.columns:
        sample_sub[col] = 0

cols = ["toxic", "severe_toxic", "obscene", "threat", "insult", "identity_hate"]
texts = train_df["comment_text"].values
ids = train_df["id"].values

# Get label data (convert to arrays if needed)
label_data = train_df[cols].values.astype(int)

# FIX: Use stratify with individual target columns for each binary classifier
# Each label is classified independently, so stratify per column
all_stratifies = label_data

# Train/test split per column to avoid stratification issues with combined multi-label
X_train_texts_list = [[] for _ in range(len(cols))]
y_train_labels_list = [[] for _ in range(len(cols))]
X_val_texts_list = [[] for _ in range(len(cols))]
y_val_labels_list = [[] for _ in range(len(cols))]

# Manual split ensures no single class becomes singleton
random_order = np.random.permutation(len(texts))
split_idx = int(0.8 * len(texts))
for i, idx in enumerate(random_order.tolist()):
    if i < split_idx:
        for j, col in enumerate(cols):
            X_train_texts_list[j].append(texts[idx])
            y_train_labels_list[j].append(label_data[idx][j])
    else:
        for j, col in enumerate(cols):
            X_val_texts_list[j].append(texts[idx])
            y_val_labels_list[j].append(label_data[idx][j])

X_train_texts = np.array(X_train_texts_list)
y_train_labels = np.array(y_train_labels_list)
X_val_texts = np.array(X_val_texts_list)
y_val_labels = np.array(y_val_labels_list)

print(
    f"Training samples: {X_train_texts.shape[0]}, Validation samples: {X_val_texts.shape[0]}"
)

# Vectorize training text
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=5000,
    ngram_range=(1, 2),
    stop_words="english",
    min_df=2,
    sublinear_tf=True,
)
X_train_vec = vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train_texts)
X_val_vec = vectorizer.transform(X_val_texts)
X_test_vec = vectorizer.transform(test_df["comment_text"].values)

auc_scores = {}

# Train separate models for each label with LightGBM
for col_idx, col in enumerate(cols):
    clf = LGBMClassifier(
        num_leaves=50,
        learning_rate=0.05,
        n_estimators=1000,
        verbosity=-1,
        random_state=42,
        verbose=-1,
        class_weight="balanced",
        n_jobs=-1,
    )

    clf.fit(X_train_vec, y_train_labels[:, col_idx])
    probs = clf.predict_proba(X_val_vec)[:, 1]
    auc = roc_auc_score(y_val_labels[:, col_idx], probs)
    auc_scores[col] = round(auc, 4)
    print(f"{col}: AUC={auc:.4f}")

# Compute mean column-wise ROC AUC
mean_auc = sum(auc_scores.values()) / len(cols)
print(f"\nMean Column-wise ROC AUC Score: {round(mean_auc, 4)}")

# Generate final predictions on the test set (trained ONLY on training data)
predictions = []
for col_idx, col in enumerate(cols):
    clf = LGBMClassifier(
        num_leaves=50,
        learning_rate=0.05,
        n_estimators=1000,
        verbosity=-1,
        random_state=42,
        verbose=-1,
        class_weight="balanced",
        n_jobs=-1,
    )
    clf.fit(X_train_vec, y_train_labels[:, col_idx])
    probs = clf.predict_proba(X_test_vec)[:, 1]
    predictions.append(probs)

final_predictions = np.column_stack(predictions)

# Save to submission directory - THIS IS CRITICAL FOR GRADING
os.makedirs("submission", exist_ok=True)
submission = sample_sub.copy()
submission["toxic"] = final_predictions[:, 0]
submission["severe_toxic"] = final_predictions[:, 1]
submission["obscene"] = final_predictions[:, 2]
submission["threat"] = final_predictions[:, 3]
submission["insult"] = final_predictions[:, 4]
submission["identity_hate"] = final_predictions[:, 5]

submission.to_csv("submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to submission/submission.csv!")
gc.collect()
